text.name: Marshadow

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Let Loose
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may have each player shuffle their hand into their deck and draw 4 cards.

attacks.name: Shadow Punch
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

text.flavor: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never reveals its true form to humans.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Wonder Tag
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Energy Drive
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to both Active Pokémon. This damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

attacks.label: GX
attacks.name: Tapu Cure
attacks.text: Heal all damage from 2 of your Benched Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

rules.label: Pokémon-GX rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Ultra Ball
effect: Discard 2 cards from your hand. If you do, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Max Elixir
effect: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck and attach a basic Energy card you find there to a Basic Pokémon on your Bench. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Professor Sycamore
effect: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Puzzle of Time
effect: You may play 2 Puzzle of Time cards at once.
◆ If you played 1 card, look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back in any order.
◆ If you played 2 cards, put 2 cards from your discard pile into your hand.

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Stormy Winds
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard the top 3 cards of your deck. If you do, attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dragon Break
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage times the amount of basic {Grass} and basic {Lightning} Energy attached to your Pokémon.

attacks.label: GX
attacks.name: Tempest
attacks.text: Discard your hand and draw 10 cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

rules.label: Pokémon-GX rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Mysterious Treasure
effect: Discard a card from your hand. If you do, search your deck for a Psychic or Dragon Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Oranguru

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Instruct
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may draw cards until you have 3 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

text.flavor: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.

text.name: Escape Rope
effect: Each player switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon. Your opponent switches first. (If a player does not have a Benched Pokémon, that player doesn't switch Pokémon.)

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Guzma
effect: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. If you do, switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Choice Band
effect: The attacks of the Pokémon this card is attached to do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon-GX or Active Pokémon-EX (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

rules.label: Pokémon Tool
rules.text: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Acro Bike
effect: Look at the top 2 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Discard the other card.

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Field Blower
effect: Choose up to 2 in any combination of Pokémon Tool cards and Stadium cards in play (yours or your opponent's) and discard them.

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Lillie
effect: Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. If it's your first turn, draw cards until you have 8 cards in your hand.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Rescue Stretcher
effect: • Put a Pokémon from your discard pile into your hand.
• Shuffle 3 Pokémon from your discard pile into your deck.

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Float Stone
effect: The Pokémon this card is attached to has no Retreat Cost.

rules.label: Pokémon Tool
rules.text: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Super Rod
effect: Shuffle 3 in any combination of Pokémon and basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Flashing Head
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon that have any Special Energy attached to them.

attacks.name: Rumbling Wires
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. Add a card you find there to their Prize cards face down. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)
